create_RejectionSampler: create a RejectionSampler instance with a Sampler and SpeculativeConfig for speculative decoding
run_strict_rejection_sample: run strict_rejection_sample to compare target and draft sampled tokens and return sampled tokens with counts
run_probabilistic_rejection_sample: run probabilistic_rejection_sample with processed logits and draft logits for acceptance sampling
run_synthetic_rejection_sample: run synthetic_rejection_sample using base acceptance rate and decay factor for synthetic speculative decoding
review_RejectionSampler_call: review the RejectionSampler.__call__ method that dispatches strict, probabilistic, or synthetic rejection sampling
